title: Inside Sink Drainage: How the Trap Protects Your Home
description: Every functional sink relies on a specific mechanical layout to operate safely and cleanly. The P-trap beneath a basin is not just a random bend in the pipe; it is a critical safety device designed to hold a standing plug of water. This water seal blocks sewer gases, unpleasant odors, and pests from entering the living space through the fixture opening. Knowing how sink drainage components interact helps you perform routine maintenance, troubleshoot minor leaks, and understand proper trap alignment.
